steps.title: Prepare specimen
steps.instruction: Remove the sample from the preservation alcohol and place it in a Petridish under the stereoscope; place the cephalothorax and legs on a paper towel to blot excess alcohol; discard the abdomen; let the remaining tissue sit at room temperature for 5 minutes to allow any remaining alcohol to evaporate.

substeps.instruction: Remove sample from alcohol and place in Petridish under stereoscope.
Blot cephalothorax and legs on paper towel.
Leave at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Freeze sample
steps.instruction: Transfer the tissue to a pre‑chilled (liquid nitrogen for 15 seconds) 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, then add approximately 1 mL liquid nitrogen to freeze the sample completely.

substeps.instruction: Pre‑chill tube with liquid nitrogen for 15 s.
Add ~1 mL liquid nitrogen to freeze sample.

steps.title: Grind tissue
steps.instruction: Using a plastic pestle, grind the frozen sample into pieces smaller than 1 mm or into a fine powder.

steps.title: Lyse cells with CTAB
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL CTAB buffer (containing 2 % v/v CTAB, 100 mM NaCl (1.4 M), 20 mM EDTA disodium dihydrate, and 2 % v/v polyvinylpyrrolidone‑40).

steps.title: Add Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL Proteinase K (20 mg mL⁻¹).

steps.title: Incubate for lysis
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture overnight at 55 °C with continuous shaking at 800 rpm.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14 000 rpm, room temperature, for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Extract aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer 400 µL of the supernatant to a 2 mL tube, add 400 µL chloroform‑octanol (24:1), vortex briefly, centrifuge at 14 000 rpm, RT, 5 minutes; repeat the transfer‑add‑centrifuge sequence once more.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 400 µL supernatant to 2 mL tube.
Repeat transfer, addition, and centrifugation once.

steps.title: Remove ethanol
steps.instruction: Discard all ethanol by decantation without disturbing the pellet, centrifuge 14 000 rpm, RT, 5 minutes, vortex for 5 seconds, add 500 µL 70 % ethanol, discard the supernatant without disturbing the pellet, and centrifuge again at 14 000 rpm, RT, 5 minutes.

steps.title: Pre‑precipitation cooling
steps.instruction: Place the tubes on ice and refrigerate at –20 °C for 1 hour (or overnight), then invert the tubes for 2 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Incubate on ice at –20 °C for 1 h (or overnight).

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL cold (‑20 °C) isopropanol, invert tubes for 2 minutes, transfer 300 µL supernatant (without disturbing the organic phase) to a fresh 1.5 mL tube, and centrifuge at 14 000 rpm, room temperature, for 5 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 300 µL supernatant to new 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Invert tubes for 2 minutes, then leave them upside down on a napkin to air‑dry for 2 hours to remove excess ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Air‑dry upside down on napkin for 2 h.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the completely dry pellet in 50 µL TE buffer.
